_note: Default price table shipped with the plugin. Contains ONLY zero-price (free-tier) declarations written by scripts/gen-custom-routes.mjs from the local registry (registry/custom-routes*.yaml); zero rows carry no vendor pricing. Real per-token prices are USER DATA and are never shipped: import yours via registry/pricing.user.json or DSH_SMART_PRICING_FILE. Models without a table row resolve to a coarse tier estimate (estimated:true, priceTier free/low/mid/high, known:false) instead of any account's historical prices. See pricing.example.json for what an imported table looks like.
_source: registry/custom-routes.yaml + registry/custom-routes.user.yaml via scripts/gen-custom-routes.mjs (free-tier zero declarations only)
_unit: USD per token; cacheRead=cache-read input, cacheWrite=cache-creation input
_disclaimer: Offline published-price estimate, NOT a billing record. Subscription/gateway discounts are not reflected.
